screenshots.alt: The re:Watch popup showing unfinished videos with progress bars and an Open Feed button.
screenshots.caption: Continue unfinished videos directly from the compact popup, or open the full local feed.

screenshots.alt: The re:Watch Home feed displaying locally personalized video cards.
screenshots.caption: Home arranges the locally cached feed using watch activity and local feedback.

screenshots.alt: The re:Watch Subscriptions tab showing recent cached uploads from locally followed channels.
screenshots.caption: Subscriptions lists cached uploads from locally followed channels in chronological order.

screenshots.alt: The re:Watch Shorts tab showing short-form videos from the local feed cache.
screenshots.caption: Shorts separates locally cached short-form videos from the regular feed.

screenshots.alt: The re:Watch Playlists tab showing saved references that open their playlists on YouTube.
screenshots.caption: Saved playlist references keep useful details locally and open the original playlist on YouTube.

screenshots.alt: The re:Watch History tab listing locally stored viewing activity and progress.
screenshots.caption: History provides a dedicated view of locally recorded viewing activity.

screenshots.alt: The re:Watch Channels tab showing channels followed locally by the extension.
screenshots.caption: Channels manages the explicit channel list followed by re:Watch.

screenshots.alt: The re:Watch Analytics tab summarizing locally calculated viewing activity.
screenshots.caption: Analytics summarizes watch time and activity calculated from local extension data.

screenshots.alt: The re:Watch Settings tab showing appearance, feed, import, backup, and data controls.
screenshots.caption: Settings collects appearance, local-feed, import, backup, and data-management controls.
